note: Design backtest on FROZEN benchmark data — percent/ratio only, never a dollar figure. Re-run the identical backtest in the Strategy Lab to reproduce. The Limit Entry Scanner's pass replaces the analyzer: The frozen 1h bars carry no order book, funding or taker flow. An unread order book is not given points: the other four dimensions, 80 in all, are scaled onto 100 so the same 70 is the same fraction of what was read as a live pass that saw the book. Quote volume is a percentile across the class, so one busy market does not take the whole volume score. The backtest skips nothing for a wall or for funding, and reads each leader's side from its day and VWAP alone. Its limit rests from the bar after the one it was decided at. The figures published on the card were measured before this scale. After a fill the position runs the scanner's own exits, never the house's.
